create_ModelArguments: create a ModelArguments dataclass to configure an LLM model name, temperature, and cost limits
aggregate_APIStats: aggregate two APIStats instances using the add operator to sum tokens and costs
replace_APIStats: replace an APIStats instance with another using the replace method to update tracking values
raise_ContextWindowExceededError: raise a ContextWindowExceededError when the LLM context window limit is exceeded during inference
raise_CostLimitExceededError: raise a CostLimitExceededError when the total or per instance cost limit is exceeded
